utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the book club’s picking a new novel this week. I’m hoping they choose something good enough to keep everyone arguing a little.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: The same club that couldn’t agree on tea, you mean? Are they actually choosing a new novel or just arguing about one again?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, probably both if they’re being honest. Last I heard, they’ve narrowed it down to two and are already disagreeing about which one will make them bicker more.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I can ask around about the book club plans.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the book club. Let me know what you hear from them.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I will, and I’ll let you know what I hear.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good. What time is the book club meeting?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It starts at 7 on Thursday evening.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll be there at 7 on Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I might join if they’re still taking new people. What book are you reading this month?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, it’s _The Remains of the Day_ this month. You should come if you can; I’d like to hear what you think.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can make the book club meeting, as long as it works around pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That works — I can check a time that avoids pickup. What window is best for you?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Late afternoon after pickup would be best for me.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m in for it if we keep it simple. What time are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: How about 7 o’clock? I might be mixing up the day, but that should keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 7 o’clock works for me. Just tell me which day, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m thinking of starting a book club chat this week if you want in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Maybe—I just need to know how often you’re planning to meet and whether it’s in person or online.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I was thinking once a week, and we can keep it online to make it easy for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard a little about that, but I’m still catching up. Is the book club meeting tonight?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, it’s tonight at 7 in the community room. I’ll bring the sign-in sheet.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, I’ll be there at 7.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Have we decided on the book yet, or are we still choosing?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We’re still choosing, but I’m leaning toward a short one everyone can finish easily.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That makes sense. How short are you thinking, so I can help narrow it down?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I can make book club this week.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I’ll bring the snacks a bit late as usual.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll be there, though I might be a little quiet.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mina. I can bring over a couple of spare chairs for the book club if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. Could you bring them by before the book club starts?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll drop them off before it starts.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can check whether the book club is at the library or the community center tonight.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, I just need the place and I’m set.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll check and tell you the exact place as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can bring my copy and a couple of spare chairs if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That would help a lot, thanks. I can bring the list and meet you there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, see you there. I’ll bring my copy and the chairs.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can come, but I need to know the time and whether we’re still meeting at the library.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: What time is it, and are we definitely still meeting at the library?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think it’s at 7, and yes, we’re still meeting at the library.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds lovely, Mara. I can ask around and see who else wants to join the next meeting.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be wonderful, Jules. Thank you for asking around, and I’ll bring a few book suggestions for the next meeting.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Of course, Mara. I’ll ask around and see who else might want to join, and I’m glad you’ll bring some suggestions.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure, I can bring some snacks and keep track of who’s coming.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That sounds great, I’ll bring the drinks and join in when I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, I’ll bring the snacks and make sure I’ve got the list of names ready.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the book club picked a new read this week. I’m curious to see what everyone thinks of it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just point me to the book and I’ll catch up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — I’ll drop the title in the chat and bring a copy to the next meetup.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks — I’ll look for it and see you at the meetup.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’d be glad to join the book club, Leo. What’s the next book on the list?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: The next pick is "Pachinko." It’s a good one to start with.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Pachinko sounds like a great pick, Leo. I’m looking forward to reading it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the book club? I heard they're meeting Thursday, and you're welcome to come with me if you want.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thursday sounds good — I’d come with you.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll meet you there Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I think the book club meets at the library on Pine Street, right?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I think so. The library on Pine Street sounds right to me.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Right, the library on Pine Street.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you already pick a book for the club, or are we still deciding?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: We’re still deciding, but I’ve been leaning toward a few options and want to check everyone’s preferences first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Which few options are you considering? I’d like to know what people are choosing between.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the book club’s meeting got moved to Thursday, right? I should still be able to make it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, Thursday sounds right to me. I’ll double-check the time so we don’t show up early or anything.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, that works for me. Let me know once you’ve got the time and I’ll pencil it in.
